description: Meet Congressman Adrian Smith. As a sixth generation Nebraskan, Adrian Smith has made a difference, bringing conservative Nebraska common sense to Congress. Adrian has consistently been ranked as one of the most conservative members of Congress. Adrian serves on the Ways & Means Committee, giving Nebraskans a voice on issues important to families, farmers
